# Seald

> Seald is a web application for electronic signatures. It runs in the browser. There is no native app.

Seald lets a person upload a PDF, place signature and form fields, sign it themselves or request signatures from other people, and download the PDF. A PAdES seal is added when a seal is applied. An RFC 3161 timestamp is added when available. The audit trail is a SHA-256 audit chain. Documents can be checked on the public verification page. Templates remember fields and signers. It is free during beta.

Support: support@seald.nromomentum.com.

## Product

- Platform: web only, at https://seald.nromomentum.com
- Category: business e-signature application
- Not offered as a native mobile or desktop app
- Sign a PDF yourself, or request signatures. Everyone is invited at the same time
- Type, draw, or upload a signature
- Reusable templates that keep fields and signers
- PAdES seal (when a seal is applied)
- RFC 3161 timestamp (when available)
- SHA-256 audit chain
- Public verification of a sealed document
- Free during beta
